bug_semantics: In the Zephyr USART driver, csp_usart_open() k_calloc()s a usart_context_t and copies the caller-supplied conf->device C string into ctx->name, a fixed 11-byte field (CSP_IFLIST_NAME_MAX=10 plus NUL). The copy used unbounded strcpy. A device name of 11 or more characters writes past the heap object and can corrupt adjacent fields (rx_callback, user_data, fd) and later heap metadata. The NVD path drivers/usart/zephyr.c is the same file as src/drivers/usart/usart_zephyr.c.
flaw_origin: The overflow was written in the first addition of src/drivers/usart/usart_zephyr.c: both the 11-byte name buffer and strcpy(ctx->name, conf->device) landed together in the Zephyr UART driver commit that became e143ee74 (PR #599 rebase of 94a3b9cb). The sibling Zephyr CAN driver already used strncpy(..., sizeof(ctx->name)-1) at that time; this USART path did not. The strcpy line was unchanged until the strncpy fix.
